purpose: The single authoritative candidate ledger for ag-edgelab. Every research candidate that reached screening, freeze, or verification gets exactly one immutable record. Future agents MUST consult this ledger (and the OOS access log) before defining, freezing, or evaluating any candidate. Records are append-only: a verdict may never be edited to rescue a candidate.
append_only_rule: A record's verdict fields (STATUS, EDGE_STATUS, FAILURE_STAGE, OOS_VERDICT, ECONOMIC_VERDICT, OOS_ROLE) are immutable once written. Corrections may only ADD a clarification note with a new commit; they may never reverse a rejection.
